text:
taylor.chen: Hey @people-ops — need to start an ADA interactive process. Been having recurrent migraines that are affecting my ability to meet some deadlines and take on on-call. Want to request intermittent leave or alternative accommodations (flex start, no late meetings, temporary on-call reassign). Can we talk next steps?

maria.hr: Hi Taylor — thanks for flagging. We can do either reasonable accommodations or LOA/STD depending on duration. Quick Qs: do you want this to be confidential beyond your manager? Do you have a medical note from your PCP or neurologist?

taylor.chen: Prefer to keep details limited to people-ops + my manager. I have a note that outlines intermittent migraines and recommended reduced night shifts for ~6 weeks. I can upload to the benefits portal.

jamie.lead: Thanks for telling us, Taylor — we want to support you. From an ops side: we can pause your top priority feature for two weeks and move the last sprint tasks to Sam. Would want a short plan for coverage for the 6-week window.

sam.engineer: I can pick up the remaining integration tests and take the pager for two of the weeks. Happy to coordinate handoff doc and a quick pairing session.

maria.hr: Great. Next steps from HR: 1) Taylor uploads the medical note to the benefits portal or emails it to people-ops (confidential). 2) We run the interactive process and propose specific accommodations (adjusted start times, no meetings after 4pm, temporary on-call reassign). 3) If intermittent leave is needed, we'll discuss STD/LOA and paperwork. I'll draft an accommodation plan for you and your manager to review.

people-ops-bot: Form received: Accommodation request submitted by taylor.chen at 2076543220. Reference ID: ACC-2027-089.

taylor.chen: Uploaded the note and added the 6-week timeline in the form. Also noted that bright-screen exposure is a trigger — low-light preference would help for any onsite meetings.

maria.hr: Thanks — noted. We'll keep the note confidential. For documentation: HR will propose a written accommodation with start/end dates and performance adjustments (temporary reprioritization of quarterly goals). Manager will confirm coverage and we will set a 2-week check-in cadence.

jamie.lead: Sounds good. I proposed scope reduction in the backlog and assigned Sam. Taylor — would you be comfortable with asynchronous check-ins twice a week instead of daily standups for the duration?

taylor.chen: Yes, async twice a week works. Also would like to be removed from rotating weekend pager for 4 weeks, then reassess.

maria.hr: We can include the on-call exemption for 4 weeks in the accommodation. If symptoms persist, we can convert to intermittent leave + STD paperwork. I'll schedule a short meeting today (15m) with Taylor and Jamie to finalize the draft.

jamie.lead: Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

people-ops-bot: Calendar invite sent: ADA accommodation discussion — taylor.chen, jamie.lead, maria.hr at 15:30 today.

taylor.chen: Appreciate it. Will be offline for a medical appointment tomorrow morning (blocked on my calendar).

maria.hr: Noted. We'll keep notes in the confidential HR file and follow up after the meeting with the written accommodation. If you want, I can also point you to EAP resources and the STD contact.

taylor.chen: Yes please, EAP link would be helpful. Thank you all.
